svg.title: Kawung
svg.desc:
Four ellipses interlocking around a point, repeated on a square lattice with quarter rosettes at the corners so the tile meets itself on every edge. One of the oldest Javanese batik patterns, and the one that is purely geometric, which is why it survives being drawn as a 1.25px stroke at this size and sits beside the console grid without fighting it.
Black on transparent on purpose. This is a CSS mask, not an image: a mask reads alpha, so the colour comes from the console line token and the pattern follows the theme and the contrast preference on its own. Any other colour here would break that, and currentColor never resolves inside a mask url.
Drawn rather than taken from the web: no licence to carry, it tiles exactly, and the geometry can be edited in place.
Note for anyone editing this file: a comment may not contain two hyphens in a row, which is why this is a desc element. As a comment naming a CSS custom property it was malformed XML, Chrome failed to decode it, and a mask that will not decode is treated as fully opaque, so the pattern silently became a solid block.
